subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw accept replacing the `dist-runtime-build` pack step with this fail-closed pack-and-smoke script for the CI artifact producer?
rationale: The implementation is focused and well-proven, but the touched surface is maintainer automation: a mistake would fail artifact production rather than only changing runtime code.

options.title: Accept with exact-head proof
options.body: Merge after the current merged head or merge queue reruns `build-artifacts` and the pack-and-smoke path successfully.

options.title: Request a narrower producer change
options.body: Ask for a smaller artifact pack change if maintainers want to defer the full Gateway/ACP smoke inside the build-artifacts job.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this branch if workflow owners do not want this artifact contract enforced in CI yet.

options.title: Pause the producer change
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and decline this PR if maintainers do not want the CI artifact job to own extracted-runtime smoke coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept with exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Merge after the current merged head or merge queue reruns `build-artifacts` and the pack-and-smoke path successfully.
